title: What’s in the Box? A Preliminary Analysis of Undesirable Content in the Common Crawl Corpus
measurement_description: Detection of hate speech targeting religious groups within the Common Crawl web corpus.
findings: The paper identifies the presence of antisemitic hate speech (e.g., 'demonic jews hate white goyim!') within the Common Crawl corpus, a foundational dataset for training many large language models. The finding demonstrates that unfiltered web data contains toxic religious content which can be learned and reproduced by AI models.
